reviews.text:
I used to take my dog here all the time. The time before last the groomer told me my dog peed on the table. This is not a normal behavior for him. When I picked him up, he was shaking, he was very afraid and fearful    Because he’s a rescue this was more traumatic.  He is the calmest boy ever,  he came out  scared, but I thought maybe he just had an interaction with another dog.
Last time he came out with an infection, might’ve been ringworm I’m not sure. He had these growing round circles where he was losing fur and there was like this scaly residue in his fur.
Spent $300 at the vet just to deal with the infection

Omg had the worst experience today brought my dog in at 9 o’clock this morning and my dog still wasn’t ready by 5:30. I have never experienced this before and I only had to pay $67 only for a Wash wow. Very unprofessional. Don’t recommend.

This is the best place in
Miami to take your pet , good customer service and it’s not expensive.

Let’s start with their site. There is a very clear option to book an appointment but when you text/call they don’t take appointments just first come first serve. I’ve been there before and it would have been easy to look up my account. I got there around 9 am right after they opened. No one greeted me, I was just asked for my last name and told the poodle/doodle prices have “gone up”. I was told it would cost $250 to simply shave my M/L poodle down. I’ve had poodles for over 10 years and it has never cost more than $150 for a haircut. Let alone simply shaving them down. Ethical dog groomers charge by the dog size. Maybe an extra charge if dematting or extra services are required but this is egregious. 0/10 would not recommend. Clearly they care more about milking their clients than being a reputable business.
My dog looks like a star when he comes out of here. Very friendly place!

I have taken my dog Juno to be groomed here a couple times and everything has been fine, now I took him and he was returned very sad and frightened with a some scars on his head, and redness around his eyes, which seem to be red bumps that were not there before. I am disappointed with his cut, his hair is shorter than it was last time and he did not receive the regular schnauzer cut. Very displeased will definitely not return.
They’re great and took amazing care of Galia
I am rewatching old episodes of Kim & Kourtney Take Miami & this grooming place popped up!! They seemed super sweet & cool.. 😎 …

Took my dog Poppi for the first time this past week and she’s never looked better! They understood my requests perfectly and she came out looking absolutely adorable after a quick grooming. She is normally nervous at the groomer and was so happy when we picked her up!

EDIT: the past two times I  took my dog here there were issues and it took over 3 hours for grooming. The first time they cut her and left two red spots on her. I thought it was a one time accident. This time, my dog was terrified and the employees were extremely rude when I complained about how long she had been there. Afterward, my dog has been extremely attached to me and upset, won’t eat and is constantly licking herself. I will Not be returning and am extremely upset with this customer service.

My dog Jumpy has been going to Victor for 3 years now. My dog Jumpy is old and blind. I must say, Victor does a great job in grooming and also very kind and caring to my dog. I always feel safe and well assured that jumpy is in good hands. We're very lucky to have found Victor the groomer.

Josephine Thomas
Amazing service!! My English springer spaniel looks so well-groomed.
Excellent service, quick, easy, and great pricing. Would definitely recommend.
